basics.name: Dave Beach
basics.heroText2: A freelance developer that gets shit done
basics.summary: I’m a software engineer and geospatial practitioner focused on exploration, documentation, and making complex systems understandable. My work sits at the intersection of code, maps, and fieldwork; building tools, visualizations, and datasets that support real-world discovery. Whether I’m developing software, processing geospatial data, or mapping sites deep in the backcountry, my goal is the same: create work that’s technically solid, visually clear, and grounded in purpose.

projects.title: Northern Venture Drone Services Website
projects.description: A fast, modern, and visually immersive website built to showcase professional drone mapping and aerial services in Ontario. Designed to reflect the spirit of exploration and precision behind the brand, it combines sleek performance with subtle motion and a modern aesthetic.
subDescription: Built with Astro + React: Delivers lightning-fast performance and seamless component-driven design.
Styled with TailwindCSS: Clean, responsive layout optimized for all screen sizes.
Enhanced with GSAP Animations: Smooth, natural motion effects that create an engaging, cinematic feel.
Focused on Clarity and Impact: Bold visuals, concise messaging, and an intuitive structure that communicates professionalism and trust.

work.name: Northern Venture Drone Services
work.summary: Founder and lead drone pilot of a specialized aerial services company, delivering innovative solutions across agriculture, mining, construction, utilities, wildlife conservation, historical preservation, and more.
responsibilities: Lead drone operations for aerial surveys, photogrammetry, 3D mapping, and infrastructure inspections.
Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights and data-driven decision-making through advanced drone technology.
Manage business development, client acquisition, and strategic partnerships to expand market reach in diverse industries.
Ensure compliance with aviation regulations and safety standards, including Transport Canada certifications.
Analyze and process aerial data to provide comprehensive reports and high-resolution visualizations.
